verdict.rationale: A voice agent platform could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only generic function calling, where your application executes the actions, and an MCP server built into the dg CLI. That server exposes Deepgram APIs to coding tools, which is the server role and does not show the Voice Agent consuming external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows the agent connecting to or using MCP servers.
